name: 086.5 — a file you loaded is an object
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 086.5: an image, a mesh, a data file, a font and a map drawing are userdata with a closed vocabulary and a __tostring that names the file — so a write to one and a typo on one both raise, a forged look-alike is refused, and identity through the stylesheet survives.
